sources.title: Broncos sign WR Mike Woods
sources.description: According to NFL Network insider Tom Pelissero, the Denver Broncos are signing veteran wide receiver Mike Woods after participating in their rookie minicamp this past weekend on a tryout basis. According to The Denver Post’s Luca Evans, it’s a standard one-year, vet-minimum deal for Woods. This signing puts the Broncos at 92 players currently on […]
